title: Endoplasm
description: The End finally has a slime, and it eats blocks. Feed a violet gel cube obsidian and get crying obsidian back. It teleports its prey, splits when killed, grows from chorus fruit, and rides home in a bucket. The conversion table is yours to edit. Fabric.
body:
# Endoplasm

**The End finally has a slime, and it eats blocks.**

Out on the outer End islands, violet gel cubes hop between the chorus trees.
Get too close and one will come for you. About half the hits a big one lands
will chorus-teleport you somewhere you did not plan to be.

But catch one alive, and you've got yourself a portable block converter.

## Watch it work.

Hand a big Endoplasm a block of obsidian. It freezes dead still, the block
sinks into its gel, and four seconds later it spits out **crying obsidian**.
Keep stuffing blocks in. It holds the whole batch and pops everything out
converted at once.

## The menu

Most conversions run **both ways**: feed it the output and you get the input
back.

| Feed it | Get back | Both ways? |
|---|---|---|
| Obsidian | Crying Obsidian | yes |
| Gravel | Sand | yes |
| Terracotta | Red Sand | yes |
| Copper Block | Oxidized Copper | one way |
| Exposed Copper | Oxidized Copper | one way |
| Weathered Copper | Oxidized Copper | one way |
| Oxidized Copper | Block of Raw Copper | yes |
| Iron Block | Block of Raw Iron | yes |
| Gold Block | Block of Raw Gold | yes |
| Cobblestone | End Stone | yes |
| Dried Kelp Block | Hay Bale | yes |
| Magma Block | Netherrack | yes |
| Nether Wart Block | Warped Wart Block | yes |
| Crimson Stem | Warped Stem | yes |
| Crimson Hyphae | Warped Hyphae | yes |

The whole table lives in one little file (`config/endoplasm_warps.json`), so
you can rewrite it however you want. Any item to any item, one way or both.
Go nuts.

## Raise your own

Small Endoplasms grow up on their own in 20 minutes, or you can speed-run it
with chorus fruit: five fruits and it pops to full size on the spot. Scoop the
grown one up in a bucket, carry it home, and plop your new pet block-warper
down wherever you like. Bucketed ones never despawn.


Original concept by u/NateTSO on Reddit (r/minecraftsuggestions). Built by
BeansNToast.
